note: Bruges: the second enceinte of 1297 (double moat, earthen rampart, stone gates), converted into a bastioned fortress from 1614; traced from the Ferraris map (1777) along the main rampart.
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Brugge' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140001)
